mapper.select: SELECT scene_id, scene_name, scene_desc, scene_type, catalog_item_id, scene_status, scene_icon, prologue FROM bt_bot_scene WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND scene_id = #{sceneId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_desc, a.scene_type, a.scene_status, a.catalog_item_id, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.creator_id, a.updator_id, a.remark, a.prologue, (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName", (SELECT u.user_icon FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorIcon" FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A'
AND a.scene_name LIKE
#{query.searchContent}
AND a.scene_type IN (#{sceneType})
AND a.scene_type != 'a2a'
AND a.scene_status = #{query.sceneStatus}
AND a.scene_status IN (#{sceneStatus})
AND a.catalog_item_id IN (#{catalogItemId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label_object_rel r WHERE a.scene_id = r.object_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id IN (-1, #{query.tenantId}) AND r.label_id IN (#{labelId}))
AND a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_desc, a.scene_type, a.scene_status, a.catalog_item_id, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.creator_id, a.updator_id, a.remark, a.prologue, b.skill_count, c.platform_name, c.platform_icon, (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.creator_id) AS "creatorName", (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.updator_id) AS "updatorName" FROM bt_bot_scene a LEFT JOIN bt_a2a_agent b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.agent_id = a.scene_id AND a.scene_type = 'a2a' LEFT JOIN bt_a2a_platform c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.platform_id = b.platform_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_scene_rel r WHERE a.scene_id = r.scene_id and a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.bot_id = #{query.botId}) AND a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
AND a.scene_name LIKE
#{query.searchContent}
AND a.scene_type IN (#{sceneType})
AND a.scene_type != 'a2a'
AND a.scene_status IN (#{sceneStatus})
AND a.catalog_item_id IN (#{catalogItemId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_label_object_rel r WHERE a.scene_id = r.object_id AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.tenant_id IN (-1, #{query.tenantId}) AND r.label_id IN (#{labelId}))
ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC
